CLI

garage

CLI

The CLI initializes and upgrades project configuration; validates, shows, and changes settings; records private local workflow events; installs and verifies canonical skills and adopted manuals; reads issue or pull-request workflow status through gh; and reports its version. It does not execute workflows, configure agents, connect AI providers, load plugins, or provide remote services.

Requirement
Go 1.27.4 to build from source
Technical details
Source revision
v0.1.1 · 7c06292

Download a prebuilt CLI

Download garage v0.3.0 for macOS, Linux, or Windows on amd64 and arm64. Prebuilt executables do not require Go.

Verify the signed checksum manifest and your archive's checksum before running it; GitHub artifact attestations are also available. Follow release verification and terminal extraction instructions ↗.

Check the release notes for current platform signing status. Gatekeeper or SmartScreen warnings may appear. Integrity and provenance verification do not replace operating-system publisher trust.

Or build from source

macOS and Linux
git clone https://github.com/bdonaldharris/builder-garage.git
cd builder-garage
git checkout 7c062921a2f2c380da1031fad1e60cfe06a4c944
./install.sh
garage version

Requires Go 1.27.4 to build. The source installer supports macOS and Linux and installs to ~/.local/bin without changing PATH. On Windows, build by hand. Compiled executables do not require Go at run time.

A plain go build ./cmd/garage reports dev; the source installer derives its version from Git.
